title: The 53-Year Journey: How the Knicks Finally Ended the Longest Drought
description:
The New York Knicks ended a 53-year championship drought in June 2026, defeating the San Antonio Spurs to win their first title since 1973. This is the full story of the longest championship drought overcome in NBA history—from the wilderness years of dysfunction and heartbreak, through Leon Rose's patient rebuild, Jalen Brunson's $113 million sacrifice, and the Villanova connection that changed everything. We explore the historic playoff run (16-3 record, +283 point differential), the double-digit comebacks in every Finals win, and what this championship means for a franchise and city that waited over half a century. With training camp approaching and the defending champions preparing to run it back, we break down the journey from 1973 to 2026 and what comes next for the Knicks.
